sampling_se_check.interpretation: The 0.015 target was the expected SE for overall accuracy at sample design time. The draw meets it (0.01499). The 0.01485–0.01628 Olofsson OA SEs in the final report are realized label-dependent SEs, not a failed sampling allocation.

efg_reference_budget_options.scope: Incremental independent, determinate labels added to the completed 821-point analysis sample.
efg_reference_budget_options.method: A-optimal EFG reference-area allocation: new draws in the nine EFG x mapped-class cells minimise the summed squared relative standard errors of the nine EFG x reference-condition areas.
efg_reference_budget_options.planning_proportions: Final observed EFG x mapped-cell reference proportions

options.recommendation: Targeted interim update: reduce the highest-uncertainty Arid and Mesic reference-area estimates.

Preferred EFG option: brings every projected EFG x reference-condition area margin below 19%, if current class proportions persist.
